audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is credited to Cassiopeia in both layers — content win[0] is 'Cassiopeia' and phases[0] is 'Cassiopeia 3/10' — while the page's own early section opens 'She literally cannot fight your level 1' and whys[0] says 'You take Cannon Q and out-range her'. The packet level chart also gives level 1 to Jayce.
audit.why: Riot's text backs the prose, not the chart: at level 1 she has a single rank of Noxious Blast (3.5s, 850 range) and no Twin Fang, and Serpentine Grace is a move-speed multiplier that does nothing without boots or a Q hit. A 3/10 at level 1 tells the player to concede the one stage he actually owns.
audit.corrected: phases[0] rated 7/10 with a reason that matches the prose. The side field could not be changed (see notes).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why for level 6 is champion-wide boilerplate ('six abilities against his four') and never names Petrifying Gaze or the facing rule; no spike anywhere carries a cooldown number.
audit.why: The mirror audit raised the same defect from the other side. Petrifying Gaze at 120s and Miasma at 24s are the two numbers that turn this from a vibe into a plan.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around the facing rule; the real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns and the dos entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twin Fang's cooldown and its healing are never stated. The page says only that she 'out-sustains Hammer form' and that her poison 'grinds' — as if this were a damage-over-time race.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 0.75 second cooldown, increased damage to poisoned targets, and it heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. It is not a race you can win by chipping; _missing-interactions.json flags this pair for anti-heal for exactly this reason. Knowing it is effectively always up changes the instruction from 'poke more' to 'burst once, then leave'.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns described Miasma's grounding correctly but gave no duration, so there was nothing to count.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s — the longest cooldown in her kit by a wide margin. A missed Miasma is a 24-second window at rank 1, which is the whole basis for stepping up.
audit.corrected: The 24s figure now appears in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0] and dosFull[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Cassiopeia is referred to as 'he'/'him'/'his' in twenty-two full-layer fields including tldr, winCon and four report entries, and dosFull[2] / dontsFull[1] carry descriptions copied from unrelated template lines.
audit.why: Wrong pronouns and mismatched title/description pairs read as unmaintained data.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected throughout; both descriptions rewritten with real mechanics.

notes: Two chart fields I could not correct: content win[0] and full phases[0].side both read 'Cassiopeia' and should read 'Jayce'. A five-to-ten character enum change cannot land inside the applier's +/-10% length band, so I corrected phases[0].rating and phases[0].why instead and am flagging the side fields for a hand fix or a mirror-fix pass. Reused from audits/top/cassiopeia__jayce.json rather than re-researched: that Thundering Blow is NOT a dash (so Miasma's grounding does not deny it — what grounding actually denies is To the Skies!, which the content layer here already states correctly), and that the full layer's seven phase 'why' strings are champion-wide boilerplate shared word-for-word with Cassiopeia's Jax, Karma and Kayle rows. I rewrote the two worst of those seven rather than fabricate five more power shifts.
